text:
maya: Heads up — I'm working on an 'inspect' toggle in the console to surface sampled request/response payloads for debugging. Need quick opinions on PII redaction, sampling rates, and audit controls.

alex: Legal already flagged raw payload exposure. We should default to masked view and require breakglass/audit for raw.

olivia: Strong +1. Masked view should hash identifiers (user id) and redact emails/phones. Also require an audit entry whenever someone opens inspect.

sam: Technical note: right now sampled artifacts live in Redis for 24h then archived to S3. Redaction must run before we store anywhere — otherwise we leak. Our deid heuristics are decent but model-backed NER fallback needed; current false-neg rate ~6% on free-text.

maya: Quick proposal: global sample 0.5%, canary buckets 2%, and full payload only for explicit opt-in sessions + auditors. Redact via deterministic regex rules + NER model as fallback. Thoughts?

james: @maya sounds reasonable. How do we avoid sampling bias (e.g., short response routes getting disproportionate samples)?

maya: @james good call — add per-route rates and a min-token threshold. E.g., skip sample if request token_count < 8 unless route is explicitly flagged.

alex: UI/Policy: 'Show raw payload' must be off by default, require AAD group membership + justification, and each toggle should create an immutable audit record.

sam: Implementation sketch for routing/sampling config:
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"pattern": "/v1/chat*", "rate": 0.02},
    {"pattern": "/v1/embeddings", "rate": 0.005, "pii_redact": true}
  ],
  "global_min_tokens": 8
}
```
Redaction runs inline in the write path before enqueue to Redis/S3.

olivia: Security asks for encryption-at-rest with per-tenant KMS for Private/Dedicated. Hosted can use platform key but enterprise should be BYOK.

maya: Agreed — artifacts encrypted with per-customer keys for Private/Dedicated; hosted uses our managed key with enterprise opt-in for BYOK.

james: For rollout and ops: can we show sampled counts/coverage in the console and a live 'audit stream' filterable by route/model/region?

maya: Yes, but live stream must show redacted view unless user has breakglass role. We'll also need throttling on the stream to protect perf.

alex: Regulatory: GDPR DSAR — we must be able to erase a sampled artifact on request. Retention TTL should be configurable per-tenant and erasure must hit backups.

sam: Current flow deletes from Redis via TTL, but backups in S3 require a purge path and metadata index to find all copies. I'll add sweep/purge endpoints.

olivia: Add an integrity hash/checksum for each artifact so we can identify copies reliably across stores.

maya: Action items: sam -> design storage + purge + inline-redact; olivia -> KMS/BYOK and encryption checklist; alex -> draft console access policy + audit requirements; james -> mock dashboard showing sample coverage and live stream UX. I'll loop in legal. Please ping me in 48h for a sync.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket RF-3421 for 'inspect-mode sampling design' and linked PR #4428.

james: :thumbsup:
